# .github directory

This directory contains GitHub specific configuration and reusable assets used by the default .github repository.

See ../README.md for the repository overview and usage.

## Contents
- workflows/ - reusable workflows
- instructions/ - Copilot instruction files
- ISSUE_TEMPLATE/ - issue templates
- PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md - default pull request template
- copilot-instructions.md - organization wide Copilot instructions
- FUNDING.yml - sponsorship configuration
